beats.care: Global diesel prices shape trucking costs, airfares and inflation in India too, so cheaper diesel abroad can ease prices here.
beats.what: After a call between Trump and Putin, the US is allowing Russian diesel to be sold on world markets until April 2027.
beats.why: Diesel prices are at records. Attacks on Russian and Saudi refineries cut supply, and US midterm elections are close.

cards.body: The plan starts with about 300,000 tonnes, rising to 500,000 tonnes in November and more later. Brent crude was about $104 a barrel on Friday.

a.body: Fuel is so costly that families and businesses everywhere are hurting. More supply brings prices down.
a.label: Supporters say

b.body: Easing sanctions without a lasting peace deal could let Russia keep paying for its war.
b.label: Ukraine's Zelenskyy says

cards.body: Diesel runs trucks, buses, trains and farm pumps. When it gets expensive, the cost of moving almost everything goes up, including food.
cards.title: why does diesel matter so much?

opts: To bring down record diesel prices
cards.q: Why did the US ease sanctions on Russian diesel?
cards.why: With supply squeezed and prices at records, more Russian diesel on the market is meant to cool fuel prices.

hook: The US let *Russian diesel* back in. Why your fuel bill cares
